NAZARA TECHNOLOGIES: APPOINTS CON ANTHONY CONLON AS INDEPENDENT DIRECTOR 👨‍💼

• 🏛️ Board appointed Con Anthony Conlon as an Additional Independent Director, subject to shareholders' approval

• 📅 Proposed tenure of 5 years, effective August 3, 2026

• 🌍 Conlon is a technology entrepreneur with extensive experience in building, scaling and exiting businesses across Europe and India

• 🤖 Founder of Merit Data & Technology, a leading provider of data, analytics and AI solutions

• 📈 Brings strong expertise in technology, AI, strategic growth and value creation, along with public company board experience

NAZARA TECHNOLOGIES: APPOINTS EX-GOOGLE EXECUTIVE RAYMOND STAUFFER AS CEO 🎮🚀

• 🌍 Raymond is a former Google executive and founder of Bluetile Games (Playvalve) and BestPlay Systems

• 📱 Built a gaming portfolio with 17 live games, 375 million lifetime downloads and 22 million monthly active users

• 💰 In 2025, his businesses generated $153.6 million revenue and $27.7 million EBITDA (18% margin)

• 🤖 Brings expertise in product strategy, user acquisition, monetization, live operations, data and AI to lead Nazara's next growth phase

🟢 Impact: Positive (Experienced global gaming executive strengthens Nazara's leadership and execution capabilities.

NAZARA TECHNOLOGIES: APPOINTS NEW CEO, NITISH MITTERSAIN CONTINUES AS MD 👨‍💼🎮

• 🔄 Raymond Albaladejo Stauffer appointed as CEO effective September 1, 2026

• 👨‍💼 Nitish Mittersain resigns as CEO but will continue as Managing Director & Key Managerial Personnel

• 🎯 Mittersain will focus on long-term strategy, portfolio direction, strategic partnerships and key stakeholder relationships

• 🤝 He will work closely with the new CEO, Board and leadership team to drive Nazara's next phase of growth

• 👏 Board acknowledged and appreciated Mittersain's contributions as CEO

🟢 Impact: Positive (Leadership transition with continuity in strategic direction supports Nazara's long-term growth plans.)

• 🔄 Investment will be made through a combination of primary subscription and secondary share acquisition

• 📈 Nazara's stake in Funky Monkeys will increase to around 68.1% on a fully diluted basis

• 🏢 Funky Monkeys will continue to remain a subsidiary of Nazara Technologies

• 🎯 Investment aims to strengthen Nazara's presence in the indoor family entertainment and gaming segment

🟢 Impact: Positive (Higher ownership strengthens Nazara's control over a growing experiential gaming business and supports long-term expansion.)

Emerald Finance Limited Expands EWA Network - Onboards Antierly Schools & Beyond Private Limited, Punjab

Emerald Finance Limited has entered into a new employer partnership with Antierly Schools & Beyond Private Limited, Punjab, extending its Early-Wage-Access (EWA) program to their employees.

EWA at a Glance:
* Employees can access a portion of their earned salary at any point during the month
* Salary-linked advance disbursed in close coordination with the employer
* Automatic repayment through monthly payroll deductions
* Fully structured, transparent and compliant process

Growing EWA Footprint:
This partnership reinforces Emerald Finance's growing employer network across India, empowering employees with greater control over their finances and reducing dependency on the traditional fixed pay cycle.

This collaboration reflects Emerald Finance's continued commitment to expanding its EWA network across India, making earned wage access a standard and trusted employee benefit - structured, responsible and built for the modern workforce.

🇰🇷 SOUTH KOREA MARKET SEES RECORD VOLATILITY; POLITICAL PRESSURE MOUNTS 📉

• 📊 KOSPI has swung 5% or more in 32 sessions this year, its most volatile period on record

• 📉 Index crashed ~40% from its June peak, rebounded 18% in a single day, then fell 5% the next session

• ⚡ Leveraged ETFs linked to Samsung and SK Hynix amplified volatility, accounting for over 70% of trading at one stage

• 💸 Sharp swings triggered heavy losses for retail investors, leading to criticism of the government's response

• 🏛️ Finance Minister apologized, the central bank held an emergency meeting, and opposition leaders questioned the ETF rollout timing

🔴 Impact: Negative for South Korean market sentiment in the near term due to heightened volatility and policy uncertainty.

• ⚡ Transaction also includes a controlling stake in WWIL's ~600 MW IPP and power sales business, subject to the approved resolution plan

• 🌍 Portfolio spans Karnataka, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh

🟢 Impact: Positive (Strengthens Inox Green's renewable O&M business and expands its presence in the wind energy sector.)

JAIN RESOURCE Q1: COPPER EXPANSION DRIVES STRONG GROWTH; MULTIPLE PROJECTS ON TRACK

• 🚀 Company continues investing in innovation, digital transformation and sustainable operations to strengthen long-term fundamentals

JINDAL STAINLESS Q1: REVENUE UP 10.5%, PAT RISES 7.6% DESPITE GEOPOLITICAL DISRUPTIONS 🏗️⚙️

• 🚗 Strong demand from automotive, infrastructure, manufacturing and consumer sectors, with healthy growth in white goods, metro rail and railway segments

• 🛢️ Secured new orders for specialised stainless steel grades across the power, oil & gas sectors; Special Product Division continued sequential growth

• ⚠️ Production was temporarily impacted by Middle East-led industrial gas supply disruptions, but the company mitigated the impact through alternative fuel usage

• 📦 Finished goods sales volume stood at 5.81 lakh tonnes, supported by continued focus on value-added products

• 🌍 Exports remained stable at 11% of sales, aided by stronger opportunities in South Korea, Japan and Brazil, alongside continued presence in Europe and the US

• 💪 Consolidated net debt stood at ₹2,950 crore, with a healthy net debt-to-equity ratio of 0.14x

ATHER ENERGY Q1: DEMAND SURGES, AURIC PLANT & NEW EL PLATFORM TO DRIVE NEXT GROWTH PHASE ⚡🛵

• 📈 EV industry registrations rose 68% YoY to ~5.25 lakh units, while EV penetration crossed 10% for the first time in June 2026

• 🔥 Ather customer enquiries jumped 95% YoY to 7.07 lakh, while pre-orders surged 158% YoY to 1.5 lakh, with demand exceeding production capacity

• 🏭 Factory 3.0 at AURIC remains on track, with Phase 1 (5 lakh units annual capacity) set to commence production in Q3 FY27

• 🚀 On completion of both phases at AURIC, Ather's total installed manufacturing capacity will reach 14.2 lakh electric two-wheelers annually

• 🛵 Ather will unveil its first production scooter on the all-new EL platform at Ather Community Day on August 29, 2026, targeting a much larger customer base

• 💬 Management said strong demand, new product launches and capacity expansion position the company well for its next phase of growth

ATHER ENERGY Q1: EBITDA TURNS POSITIVE AS SCALE DRIVES PROFITABILITY ⚡🛵

• 📈 Total income surged 87.2% YoY to ₹1,260 crore, driven by strong volume growth, calibrated pricing and higher non-vehicle revenue

• 🚀 Delivered 83,173 electric two-wheelers (+80.5% YoY), with customer demand continuing to outpace production

• 💰 EBITDA turned positive at ₹9 crore, compared to a loss of ₹106 crore in Q1 FY26, improving by 1,650 bps YoY

• 📉 Net loss narrowed sharply to ₹51 crore from ₹178 crore a year ago, reflecting improving operating leverage

• 🔋 Non-vehicle revenue, including software subscriptions, charging, accessories, spares and service, increased to 14% of revenue (vs. 13% in Q1 FY26)

• ⚙️ Despite commodity inflation, Ather sustained margins through pricing actions, value engineering, product mix optimization and supplier cost reductions

Two tankers carrying Saudi oil exited Red Sea over weekend
Two tankers carrying Saudi Arabian crude crossed the Bab al-Mandeb strait over the weekend, according to the Reuters news agency, in a sign that oil shipments continue to pass the waterway despite a Houthi threat to blockade the kingdom.

The Iran-aligned group declared a maritime embargo against Saudi Arabia on July 20, and launched several attacks on oil tankers in the Red Sea, opening a new front in the US-Israel war on Iran.

Reuters, citing data from Kpler, a maritime analytics firm, reported that the Malta-flagged Lesvos was carrying about 1 million barrels of Saudi crude to an unknown destination, while Desh Vaibhav, carrying two million barrels, was heading to Reliance Industries-run Sikka port in India.

Both oil tankers exited the Red Sea with their automatic identification systems switched ‌off, it said.

Overall, the data shows that the number of vessels that passed through the strait on Sunday fell to ⁠18, down from 27 on Saturday and 28 on Friday, it added.

text: Axis Capital on India Industrials- Expert session takeaways - India’s data center opportunity

Aimtron : Initiation of coverage by Nuvama (31 July 2026)

AIMTRON focuses on high-value, niche markets, and specialty businesses rather than competing in high-volume, low-margin segments. Its focus has been on critical nature industries in the industrial EMS segment as it evolves from a pure play PCB assembler to a box-build and original design manufacturer.

AIMTRON operates in the industrial B2B EMS space, where lower volumes are offset by better pricing given the complex, safety-critical, and customised nature of products, as reflected in its industry-leading margin and returns. Despite delivering the fastest growth vis-à-vis its peers, it trades cheaper at 17.3x FY28E EV/EBITDA and 27.2x P/E. The stock currently trades at a significant discount to its B2B ESDM peer set which we believe will close as the company scales. We initiate with a ‘BUY’ rating valuing the company at 40x FY28E diluted EPS of INR 50.9 resulting in a target price of INR 2,036.

AIC acquisition to bolster US presence : 

The acquisition provides AIMTRON with four SMT lines, with end-to-end capabilities, in a 58,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility. It also has 3.9 acres of land available for future expansion. AIC’s expertise lies in high-reliability electronics, ruggedised products, and box-build manufacturing. The facility is close to major industrial OEMs such as Caterpillar, Deere & Company, CNH Industrial, and Bunn-O-Matic Corporation, thus providing a much faster route to expanding its US manufacturing footprint than building a greenfield facility.

AIC generated USD16.9mn (~INR160cr) of revenue in CY2025 and contributed USD1.6mn (~INR15cr) to the group's consolidated revenue during its first two months of consolidation in FY26 (February–March). During this period, its revenue was primarily driven by ruggedised electronics (26%), meditech (19%), BESS (17.8%), and defence (17.1%), highlighting strong strategic alignment with AIMTRON's core business. From a product mix perspective, PCBA/box-build solutions accounted for 64.9%/35.1% of revenue.

The management expects utilisation to scale to 90% from 54%, increasing its annual revenue potential to USD25–30mn (INR280–300cr) over the next three years. While AIC operated at an EBITDA margin of ~11% at the time of its acquisition, it expects to quickly ramp up to standalone margin levels within two years and expects the business to be EPS accretive from the first year.

Greenfield expansion to enhance ESDM positioning

The new facility will add six SMT lines in a phased manner and will also house a dedicated ODM, R&D, and defence zone to strengthen its engineering and high-precision manufacturing capabilities.

The project is being funded through preferential warrants (INR94.6cr) and internal accruals. The facility is expected to turn operational in phases from Q3 or Q4FY27, with the commissioning of the SMT line targeted by Q4FY27 or Q1FY28. On completion, the expansion is expected to potentially add ~INR500cr of annual revenue to the existing INR800–900cr over time.

Sterlite Tech: Nuvama Report and my thoughts

Nuvama has come up with an updated report on Sterlite Tech with a price target of 770.

Their earlier price target was 440, which they increased to 770 after Q11FY27 results..
That's an upgrade of 75%
Just imagine the amount of earnings surprise.

Before Q1Fy27 results, many brokerages were expecting Sterlite to generate a PAT of 400-500 crores in FY27
Now, the same brokerages are estimating FY27 PAT to be 900-100 Crores, almost an increase of 100%

Nuvama report estimates Fy27 PAT of 906 Cr.
However, this is still conservative and below the management guidance  - Nuvama has considered EBITDA margins of 20.3% whereas Company has guided for 23%

Also, Sterlite recently did a QIP of 1500 Cr. While this will lead to a dilution of 5%, the entire debt is gone on one shot and it has become a net cash company !!

Personally, I think Sterlite would cross 1000 Cr PAT for FY 27 easily and might hit 1100 Cr.

Now, the interesting part - valuations
Before Q1FY27 results, Sterlite was trading at a trailing PE of 500+. Many people looked at screener PE, and shouted bubble !!
Now, PE has already dropped to 121
On FY27 basis - Sterlite is trading at a PE of 30-32
Half of the stocks in the Indian market are trading at higher valuations !!

Always consider forward earnings and valuations.
Particularly for turnaround cases like Sterlite, it is futile to look at trailing PE !!

Company Overview:
Advit Jewels Limited is a Jaipur-based luxury jewellery company specializing in Kundan, Polki, Diamond, and Studded Jewellery. Backed by a family legacy dating back to 1921, the Company follows an integrated business model encompassing in-house design, manufacturing, stone setting, polishing, and quality control, serving customers across India through its design-led and quality-focused approach.

Financial Performance:

* Total Income of ₹4,322.92 Lakhs

Business & Operational Highlights:

Customer & Market Presence
* Active customer base increased from 96 to 274, with presence across 21 states.
* Continued strengthening its position in the premium bridal jewellery segment through a diversified customer base.

Product Portfolio & Manufacturing
* Specializes in Kundan, Meena, Polki, Jadau handcrafted jewellery.
* Strong design capabilities and a stable artisan ecosystem backed by over 100 years of jewellery craftsmanship.

Growth & Strategic Initiatives:

Retail Expansion
* Plans to establish 30 franchise stores over the next three years.
* Targeting the opening of at least three stores during FY27.
* A 30,000 sq. ft. flagship store in Jaipur, is expected to commence operations by this year.

Product & Market Expansion
* Expanding into men's luxury jewellery, including cufflinks, brooches and belt buckles.
* Launching a dedicated Gen-Z jewellery collection featuring lightweight, everyday luxury designs.
* Exploring export opportunities in the UK and Middle East, while strengthening domestic retail operations.

Management Commentary & Outlook:
* Remains confident of long-term growth driven by retail expansion, product diversification and increasing brand recognition.
* Focus will remain on premium craftsmanship, disciplined execution, customer experience and sustainable long-term value creation for shareholders.

Key Takeaways:
* Delivered strong double-digit growth in revenue, EBITDA and profitability during FY26.
* Successfully completed listing on the NSE and BSE, marking a significant milestone in the Company's growth journey.
* Retail expansion through franchise stores and the Jaipur flagship showroom is expected to strengthen direct consumer engagement.
